recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-14422 unless the PA work group later chooses to revisit broader Patient.contact and RelatedPerson modeling guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-14422 was a Published/Persuasive PA clarification for the STU3 Patient page. It asked to clarify the relationship between Patient.contact and RelatedPerson by saying Patient.contact stores contact details that travel with the Patient and cannot be referenced, while RelatedPerson must be used when related people need to be referenced by other resources.
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied by git commit 9e01ffe8db59a9639ff970ea60ec8caffa65d322, titled "GF#14422: Clarification on use of Patient.contact", which replaced the ambiguous Patient.contact paragraph in source/patient/patient-notes.xml with the requested clarification.
additional_context: Patient is an active core resource in source/fhir.ini, so source/patient/patient-notes.xml is in current build scope. The current source retains the clarified rule at the Patient.contact vs. RelatedPerson section, with later safe wording updates such as the corrected DocumentReference.author example. A direct community search found no Zulip or Confluence evidence that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The active Patient notes already state that Patient.contact travels with the Patient and cannot be a reference target, and that RelatedPerson must be used when related people need references from other resources.

related_jiras.note: A broad Jira search surfaced this separate RelatedPerson relationship/role issue, but it does not affect the Patient.contact clarification and was not decided.
